# PPR January 3, 2023 release

_Category: Past Releases · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**Fareen** (1/4/2023):

**Enhancement to PPR Search Result Report for large searches**

As indicated in the last PPR search release, when there are more than 700 registrations, the report will be divided into sub-reports with up to 500 registrations per sub-report. All sub-reports are contained within one PPR search report (1 PDF file). Clients will continue to see one link to the PPR search report on the dashboard. 
Now, clients will be able to see a cover page to quickly navigate to each sub-report and summary sub-report information. Large reports with file sizes greater than 32 MB can now be downloaded via the application dashboard or retrieved by the PPR API call. It may take some time to download these large reports.
